nodes.summary: Keeps ready and running jobs in memory, delays retries and parks jobs that run out of attempts.
Runs the handler for one job with a timeout and reports success or failure.
Counts completed jobs and their durations from events on the bus.

stepsUpdate.summary: The runner takes the next due job from the queue, ordered by priority and enqueue time.
A leased worker runs the job handler and returns the outcome of this attempt.
After a failed attempt with retries left, the runner delays the job and puts it back on the queue.

tours.summary: Follow the scheduling code and a failed job as it returns to the queue. The worker and metrics are shown on the map; this tour leaves their internals out.
